title: NPC personality drives tactics: the last goblin flees rather than fighting to the death

Grikt.description: The last surviving goblin of the crypt pack
Grikt.personality_traits: Cowardly; vicious in a pack; terrified alone
Grikt.combat_style: Flees when outnumbered; never fights alone

llm_context.canon: Four goblins ambushed the party; three are dead. The last, Grikt, stands alone against the whole party. Grikt's combat style is to flee when outnumbered — he never fights alone.

script.speaker: Aria
script.message: I advance on the last goblin, sword raised.

actions.text: Grikt looks at his fallen packmates, looks at your blade, and makes the only smart choice a goblin ever makes. He bolts for the northern archway, shrieking curses over his shoulder.
Not dying for a pile of bones! The crypt keeps its own!
